title: Ephemeral YubiKey-gated NixOS rescue ISO and installer
description: Coordinate a reusable RAM-loaded NixOS rescue ISO authenticated with GPG/YubiKey and sops-nix, joined to Tailscale with a unique runtime hostname, then used to install final systems with nixos-anywhere and disko. Child work is split across nix-config, nix-keys, nix-secrets, nix-lib, and this workspace.

title: Coordinate cross-repository rescue ISO rollout
description: Maintain the cross-repository execution order, dependency map, verification commands, and handoff notes for nix-config, nix-secrets, nix-keys, and nix-lib.

This merged change therefore requires mandate-protection follow-up.
